{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/penguins.csv')

# Check for missing values in 'body_mass_g'
missing_body_mass = penguins['body_mass_g'].isnull().sum()
print("Missing values in 'body_mass_g':", missing_body_mass)

# Check the data type of 'body_mass_g'
print("Data type of 'body_mass_g':", penguins['body_mass_g'].dtype)

# Check for any obvious anomalies in the body mass values
min_mass = penguins['body_mass_g'].min()
max_mass = penguins['body_mass_g'].max()
print("Min body mass:", min_mass)
print("Max body mass:", max_mass)

# Compute the mean body mass, ignoring missing values
mean_body_mass = penguins['body_mass_g'].mean()
print("Mean body mass (ignoring missing values):", mean_body_mass)"}
